evidence.title: GitHub - Inkline-Verify/ProofOfHuman: Inkline is the human approval API for AI agents · GitHub

name: Inkline
summary: Free, open-source Touch ID stamp for Gmail plus an approval API that proves a person approved an action before an AI agent runs it.
description: Inkline for Gmail is a free, open-source Chrome extension: when you hit Send, a Mac helper shows the exact message and asks for Touch ID, and the email goes out with a small stamp linking to a receipt anyone can verify offline. Stamps are Secure Enclave-signed and hardware-attested through Apple's App Attest. The paired Approval API (pilot) lets products get a person's approval on an exact action before an agent performs it, returning a verifiable receipt and a webhook.
contains: free, open-source (MIT) Chrome extension for Gmail
Touch ID-signed stamp; receipts verify offline in the browser
Approval API in pilot: exact-action approval for AI agents, with webhook
requires a Mac with Touch ID on macOS 27+, a Chromium browser and Gmail
privacy: only a SHA-256 hash of the content leaves the Mac
the notary stores just your public key and enrollment date
